; --- Standard Frame Prologue/Epilogue (RBP-based) ---
push rbp
mov rbp, rsp
sub rsp, 0x40           ; Allocate 64 bytes for locals

mov QWORD PTR [rbp-0x8], rdi ; Store arg 1
lea rsi, [rbp-0x30]     ; Address of local array

mov rsp, rbp            ; Equivalent to leave
pop rbp
ret

; --- Stack Canary Protection Check ---
; Canary stored at [rbp-0x8] upon entry
mov rax, QWORD PTR [rbp-0x8] ; Load saved canary
xor rax, QWORD PTR fs:0x28   ; Compare to TLS value

jnz stack_smash_detected     ; If comparison fails

jmp safe_exit

stack_smash_detected:
call __stack_chk_fail

safe_exit:
leave
ret

linkers_loaders_code_procedure-linkage-t.code:
; Global Offset Table (GOT)
; Used for accessing external data or resolved func addresses (PIC)
; %rip is the Instruction Pointer (IP-relative addressing)

    call_label:
        lea     (%rip), %rbx        ; Get current address (Base)
        add     $GOT_OFFSET, %rbx   ; Calculate GOT base address

    ; Read external data 'g_ext_var' address from GOT
        movq    g_ext_var@GOTPCREL(%rbx), %rax
        movl    (%rax), %ecx        ; Load data value

; Procedure Linkage Table (PLT)
; Trampoline used to resolve function addresses at runtime

    external_func@PLT:
        ; 1. Jump via the GOT entry (Indirection)
        jmp     qword ptr [external_func@GOTPCREL]

        ; If first call, GOT points here for dynamic resolution:
        ; 2. Push required relocation index onto stack
        push    $RELOC_INDEX

        ; 3. Jump to the dynamic linker resolver (GOT[2])
        jmp     qword ptr [PLT_RESOLVER_ENTRY]
        ; Linker updates GOT entry; subsequent calls skip steps 2/3

; Arg1
%rdi

%rdx
; Arg4

.text
    # Standard SysV ABI (Function Call)
.globl my_func
my_func:
    # Arguments: RDI (arg1), RSI (arg2)
    # Return value: RAX
    mov rax, rdi        # Move arg1 to result register
    add rax, rsi        # Add arg2 (RAX = arg1 + arg2)

    # Use IMUL for signed multiplication
    mov rdx, 8
    imul rdx            # RDX:RAX = RAX * RDX

    ret

.text
    # Addressing Modes (Load/Store)
.data
my_array: .quad 1, 2, 3, 4 # Array of Qwords (8 bytes each)

.text
    mov rdi, my_array   # Base address RDI
    
    # Load 4th element (Index 3 * size 8)
    mov rax, [rdi + 3*8] 

    # Load 4 bytes (Doubleword)
    movzx rbx, BYTE [rdi] # Zero-extend byte load
    
    # Store Qword at [Base + Index*Scale + Displacement]
    mov rcx, 5          # Index
    mov rsi, 0xDEADBEEF
    mov [rdi + rcx*8 + 16], rsi 


.text
    # Control Flow and Flags (CF, ZF, SF, OF)
    mov rax, 10
    mov rbx, 5
    
    cmp rax, rbx        # Compare RAX and RBX (Sets Flags)
    
    je  equal_label     # Jump if Equal (ZF=1)
    jl  less_label      # Jump if Less (Signed comparison)
    ja  greater_label   # Jump if Above (Unsigned comparison)

    jmp end_label

greater_label:
    mov rdx, 1          # True branch
    
end_label:
    nop


.text
    # Stack Frame Setup (Prolog/Epilog)
.globl my_frame_func
my_frame_func:
    push rbp            # Save old base pointer
    mov rbp, rsp        # Establish new frame base

    push r12            # Save callee-saved register
    sub rsp, 48         # Allocate local variables (48 bytes)

    # ... Function Body ...

    mov rax, [rbp - 8]  # Access local variable
    
    add rsp, 48         # Deallocate stack space
    pop r12             # Restore callee-saved register
    
    leave               # mov rsp, rbp; pop rbp
    ret

linkers_and_loaders_default_position_ind.code:
; Position Independent Code (PIC) - x86-64 Assembly
; Accessing external symbol 'global_var' via Global Offset Table (GOT)

.text
.globl pic_access

pic_access:
    ; RIP-Relative addressing to locate the GOT entry for 'global_var'.
    ; @GOTPCREL: Symbol offset relative to the Program Counter (%rip).
    
    ; Load the absolute runtime address (stored in the GOT) into RAX.
    movq global_var@GOTPCREL(%rip), %rax
    
    ; If loading the value stored at global_var:
    ; movq (%rax), %rcx
    ret

; Note: This allows the linker/loader to update the GOT
; independently of the shared library's instruction code.
